title: I Just Invested €1,000 in THESE 4 Stocks! (October 2026)
creator: The German Value Investor
summary: The German Value Investor invests another €1,000 of real money in his community portfolio, after skipping September while writing over 20 detailed analyses, buying four stocks, two of them new. He adds 10 JD.com shares (50 to 60, about €231) at about $25, citing a near-4% dividend yield plus 5-6% buybacks, net cash covering 70% of market capitalisation, an adjusted price-to-earnings ratio of just 3, and a buy limit of $44; even his negative scenario, earnings falling 10% a year for five years, gives fair value of $33, against $50 in the normal case and $90 in the positive case. He adds a little Netflix (4 to 6 shares, about €116) after its post-earnings drop. He opens an initial Booking Holdings position (2 shares, just under €300) at about $158, down from $230, with a buy limit of $130 for a larger entry; the bear case, AI agents displacing bookings, gives fair value of only $40, while the bull case more than doubles the price. He opens an initial LVMH position (1 share, just under €400) at just under €390, down about 56% from €900, on a price-to-earnings ratio of 17-18, adding more below €333; even his negative scenario breaks even. The calls are JD — BUY, NFLX — BUY, BKNG — BUY and LVMH — BUY, all with real purchases; NFLX and BKNG flip from HOLD, LVMH from CONDITIONAL_BUY.

calls.bear_case: Negative: earnings -10%/yr 5y then flat, fair P/E 7.8 -> fair value $33, still ~6%/yr average return.
